name: play_area_set
description: Choose where room courses (slalom, dash, park, hover, landing, hoops) may go in this room, saved for the room, then lay the open course out again. Use it when a course doesn't fit, or the person says the boundary is too small, wants to use the whole room, or wants to mark an area. mode: "room" uses the whole clear floor from the room scan (walls and furniture still avoided) and ignores the Quest boundary; "draw" opens drawing, where they pinch the floor to place corners and tap Done; "quest" keeps courses inside the Quest boundary; "auto" (the default) uses the Quest boundary when the course fits in it, else the room's clear floor. Tell them 'say' in your own words; for room, always include the line to stay aware of their surroundings.

name: play_area_show
description: Open the Play area panel and show the area courses use in this room as an outline on the floor. Returns the mode and sizes; say what it uses now and that they can tap to change it.

name: course_to_desk
description: Put the open room course on the table at a smaller scale (1:4 down to 1:10), for when the floor is too small or the person wants it on their desk. Works for the dash (drag race), parking, slalom, hover and landing; hoops stay on the floor. Say the result's 'say'.
